product_metadata.title: Mind Reader Bread and Biscuit Steel Canister Set Silver
features: VINTAGE LOOK - Our kitchen canister set has a vintage look for an antique feel. Nothing beats having an expensive looking countertop piece for a low price
CLASSIC - A perfect compliment to any kitchen or dining room furniture. The simplistic beauty of our metal canister set provides an excellent decorative touch to your countertop

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL - Use it in the kitchen, office, breakrooms and anywhere else you would like to organize your belongings. Can even be used as a decorative piece to your desert table. Great for parties and events. Handle on top of lid for easy access to your acessories
DIMENSIONS - 5.5 in. L x 5.5 in. W x 6.25 in. H
description: Don't keep your bread out in the open where it can get stale quickly. Instead keep them in these already-labeled canisters for bread and biscuits. It's a great way to store your grains to keep them fresh.
